children.name: Hofstenia
children.description: Hofstenia — a genus in the family Convolutidae.

children.name: Hofstenia miamia
children.description: Mature specimens ~ 4 mm long contracted and 6 – 7 mm when elongated. Specimens usually with brown coloration and numerous white spots; some white spots arranged to form three bands across the anterior, middle, and posterior portions of the body (Fig. 10 B).
